description: Study design decision / 研究设计决策推荐 | USE WHEN: the user asks which study design to use (RCT vs cohort etc.) and why; rule-based decision tree with a scoring matrix, not LLM guessing | ALIASES: 用什么设计, RCT还是队列, 设计决策, 选哪个设计, design decision, which design type | RETURNS: 推荐设计类型、框架、推荐依据、分配比例
